vocab.sentence: When Cole feels angry, he often breathes deeply to calm himself down.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 當 Cole 生氣時，他常會深呼吸，讓自己冷靜下來。

vocab.sentence: Rita was so hungry that she took a huge bite of the wheel cake and swallowed it whole.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Rita 餓極了，咬了一大口車輪餅，整口吞了下去。

vocab.sentence: Thanks to the nurse, the injury to Mike's finger soon became less painful.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 多虧護理師幫忙，Mike 手指上的傷很快就沒那麼痛了。

vocab.sentence: It is annoying that people talk during movies.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 有人在電影播放時說話，令人很煩。

vocab.sentence: The typhoon was a great disaster in this area. Many people lost their homes because of it.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這場颱風是這個地區的一場大災難，許多人因此失去家園。

vocab.sentence: We learned how to survive in the mountains.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們學了如何在山中生存。

vocab.sentence: Cockroaches are one of the creatures that I dislike the most because they make me feel sick.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 蟑螂是我最討厭的生物之一，因為牠們讓我覺得噁心。

vocab.sentence: To protect the environment, we can choose to use reusable chopsticks instead of single-use ones.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 為了保護環境，我們可以選擇使用可重複使用的筷子，而不用免洗筷。

vocab.sentence: Don't throw your trash into the river! You will pollute the water.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 別把垃圾丟進河裡！你會污染河水。

vocab.sentence: My sister loves to float her toy rubber ducks on the water when she takes a bath.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我妹妹洗澡時，喜歡讓她的玩具橡皮鴨浮在水面上。

vocab.sentence: Despite the bad weather, the boat arrived at the shore without incident.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 雖然天氣不好，船仍平安抵達岸邊。

vocab.sentence: Ryan is in urgent need of medicine, or he may become too weak to stand.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Ryan 急需藥物，否則他可能會虛弱得無法站立。

vocab.sentence: This laptop is on sale. The price has been reduced from twenty thousand to ten thousand dollars.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這台筆電正在特價，價格已從兩萬元降到一萬元。

vocab.sentence: The baby is making an effort to climb the stairs by himself.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這個寶寶正努力自己爬上樓梯。

vocab.sentence: Mandy and Brian's relationship is in crisis. They fight more and more often.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Mandy 和 Brian 的感情出現危機，他們吵架的次數越來越多。

vocab.sentence: I learned how to cook. Meanwhile, my brother washed the dishes.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我學習如何煮飯，同時我哥哥在洗碗。

vocab.sentence: Smoking is banned in this restaurant, so customers need to go outside to smoke.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這間餐廳禁止吸菸，因此顧客必須到外面抽菸。

vocab.sentence: Tickets to that show are currently available, so let's get some soon.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那場表演目前還有票，我們趕快買幾張吧。

vocab.sentence: I was wondering who put this love letter in my desk drawer.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我在想，是誰把這封情書放進我的書桌抽屜裡。

phrases.sentence: When Mary realized that she stepped on Jack's foot by accident, she immediately apologized to him.
phrases.sentence_chinese: Mary 發現自己不小心踩到 Jack 的腳時，立刻向他道歉。

phrases.sentence: Leo drank too much, so he is now throwing up in the restroom.
phrases.sentence_chinese: Leo 喝太多了，所以現在正在廁所嘔吐。

phrases.sentence: The doctor said that there was too much gas in my stomach because the food wasn't broken down well enough.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 醫生說我的胃裡有太多氣體，因為食物沒有被充分分解。

phrases.sentence: Kate decided to cut down on sugary drinks to stay healthy.
phrases.sentence_chinese: Kate 決定少喝含糖飲料，以保持健康。

tips.label: 疑問詞 + to V
tips.text: what to do（該做什麼）、where to go（該去哪裡）、when to leave（該何時離開）、who to ask（該問誰）、how to do it（如何做這件事）。to 後面用原形動詞。

tips.label: 是否要做
tips.text: whether to V 表示是否要做某事：We haven't decided whether to go. 不能把 whether 換成 if。

tips.label: 有些、其他一些、還有一些
tips.text: Some ... Others ... Still others ... 表示不同群體；Others 與 Still others 後面不再接名詞。

tips.label: 後面有名詞
tips.text: 接複數名詞時，用 some students、other students、still other students；不能寫 others students。

tips.label: 指定剩下的
tips.text: the other 表示指定範圍剩下的另一個；the others 表示剩下的全部。只有三個時可用 One ... Another ... The other ...。

notes.title: 把名詞子句簡化為名詞片語
notes.rule: wh- + S + can / could / should + V → wh- + to + 原形動詞
notes.description: 表示該做什麼或如何做時，若省略的動作者能由主要子句或上下文清楚判斷，常可簡化成疑問詞 + to V。省略的動作者可以是主要子句的主詞，也可以是受詞；不是看到 wh- 子句就一律刪掉主詞。
examples: I don't know how I can fix it. → I don't know how to fix it.（我不知道如何修好它。）
The teacher told us what we should bring. → The teacher told us what to bring.（老師告訴我們該帶什麼；帶東西的人是 us。）
I know where she lives. 是知道她住在哪裡，不能直接改成 I know where to live.，否則會變成知道該住哪裡。

notes.title: 依句意選擇疑問詞
notes.rule: what / where / when / who / how + to V；which + 名詞 + to V
notes.description: what 表示事物，where 表地點，when 表時間，who 表對象，how 表方法。which 可以接名詞，表示在選項中選哪一個。what to do 中的 what 是 do 的受詞；how to do it 中的 how 表方法，do 仍需要受詞 it。本課不使用 why to V。
examples: Please tell me what to do.（請告訴我該做什麼。）
Please show me how to do it.（請示範如何做這件事。）
We can't decide which road to take.（我們無法決定該走哪條路。）
I don't know who to call or when to leave.（我不知道該打電話給誰，或該何時離開。）

notes.title: whether 後面可以接不定詞
notes.rule: whether + to V；whether to V ... or ...
notes.description: whether to V 表示是否要做某事，也可以接 or 說明另一個選項。if 可以引導完整的名詞子句，但不能直接用 if to V。
examples: We haven't decided whether to join the cleanup.（我們還沒決定是否參加清理活動。）
They are discussing whether to stay or leave.（他們正在討論要留下還是離開。）
I don't know if I should go. 可以；I don't know if to go. 不可以。

notes.title: 原形動詞與並列動作
notes.rule: wh- + to + 原形動詞；how to V and V
notes.description: to 後面使用原形動詞，不使用 V-ing 或第三人稱單數形式。兩個並列動作可共用前面的 to，也可以各自保留 to。若是兩個不同的名詞片語，則可分別使用疑問詞。
examples: She taught me how to breathe slowly.（她教我如何慢慢呼吸。）
We learned how to find water and build a fire.（我們學了如何找水與生火；build 和 find 共用 to。）
He explained where to put the paper and how to sort the bottles.（他說明紙該放哪裡，以及如何分類瓶子。）

notes.title: 還原成子句時使用陳述句語序
notes.rule: 主要子句 + wh- + 主詞 + 動詞
notes.description: 疑問詞後若保留完整子句，主詞放在動詞或情態動詞前面；不要套用直接問句的倒裝語序。can、should 等情態動詞後接原形動詞。
examples: Where should we meet? 是直接問句。I don't know where we should meet. 是含名詞子句的句子，也可說 I don't know where to meet.。
Please tell me when I should start. → Please tell me when to start.（請告訴我該何時開始。）

notes.title: 將許多人或事物分成幾群
notes.description: Some 表示有些，Others 表示其他一些，Still others 表示還有另外一些。這種說法不一定列完全部成員，也不表示總共只有三個人或三件物品。指可數複數群體時，動詞需配合複數主詞。
examples: Some students are reading. Others are writing. Still others are drawing.（有些學生在閱讀，有些在寫字，還有一些在畫畫。）
Some drinks contain sugar. Others do not.（有些飲料含糖，其他一些則不含糖。）
Some creatures live in water, but others live on land.（有些生物住在水裡，其他一些則住在陸地上。）

notes.title: other 後有名詞，others 單獨使用
notes.rule: other + 複數名詞 = others；still other + 複數名詞 = still others
notes.description: Other students 與 Others 都可表示其他一些學生，但不能把兩種形式混成 Others students。Some 可接複數名詞，也可以單獨使用。判斷空格時先看後面是否還有名詞。
examples: Some students walk to school. Other students ride bikes.（有些學生走路上學，其他一些學生騎腳踏車。）
Some students walk to school. Others ride bikes.（others 代替 other students。）
Some shops sell food. Other shops sell clothes. Still other shops sell books.（有些商店賣食物，有些賣衣服，還有一些賣書。）

notes.title: 補充：限定範圍內剩下的人或物
notes.rule: One ... The other ...；One ... Another ... The other ...；the others / the other + 複數名詞
notes.description: 明確只有兩個時，用 one 和 the other。明確只有三個時，可以用 one、another、the other。the others 表示指定範圍剩下的全部；若後面還要接複數名詞，使用 the other + 複數名詞。another 通常修飾單數名詞，或單獨代表另一個。
examples: I have two bags. One is blue, and the other is black.（我有兩個袋子，一個藍色，另一個黑色。）
There are three cups. One is red, another is green, and the other is white.（有三個杯子，一個紅色，一個綠色，最後一個白色。）
There are ten students. Three are reading, and the other seven are writing.（共有十名學生，三人在閱讀，其餘七人在寫字。）
Two of the boxes are empty. The others are full.（其中兩個箱子是空的，其餘全部是滿的。）

quiz.question: The coach showed me how ___ slowly before the race.
quiz.hint: how 後接 to + 原形動詞，表示呼吸的方法；不能用 to breathing。

quiz.question: We practiced what ___ if a disaster happened.
quiz.hint: what to do 表示該做什麼；what 是 do 的受詞，後面用 to + 原形動詞。

quiz.question: The storm is coming. We can't decide ___ to stay here or leave.
quiz.hint: stay here or leave 提供兩種選擇；表示是否留下用 whether to stay，if 不能直接接 to V。

quiz.question: The room is still being cleaned. We haven't decided when ___ the meeting.
quiz.hint: when to start 表示何時開始；不定詞用 to + 原形 start。

quiz.question: The park has three gates. We haven't agreed on where ___.
quiz.hint: where to meet 表示會合地點；where + to V 可作 on 的受詞，不能改成 where meeting。

quiz.question: The sign tells visitors who ___ if there is an urgent problem.
quiz.hint: who to call 表示該打電話給誰；who 是 call 的受詞，後面用 to + 原形動詞。

quiz.question: The guide explained how ___ in the mountains without a phone.
quiz.hint: how to survive 表示生存的方法；疑問詞後用 to + 原形 survive。

quiz.question: We have two ways to reduce waste, but we can't decide which method ___.
quiz.hint: which method to use 表示該採用哪種方法；疑問詞可先接名詞 method，再接 to V。

quiz.question: Dad showed me how ___ on sugary drinks.
quiz.hint: how 後接 to + 原形動詞；完整內容為 how to cut down on sugary drinks，考的是不定詞形式。

quiz.question: The bag is full of broken glass. Please tell me how ___ it safely.
quiz.hint: how to carry it 表示如何搬它；how 後用 to carry，不能用 to carrying。

quiz.question: Please show the children ___ to do with their trash.
quiz.hint: do 缺少『做什麼』的受詞，所以用 what to do；how 表方法，不能代替 do 缺少的受詞。

quiz.question: My little sister doesn't know ___ to swallow a large pill.
quiz.hint: swallow 已有受詞 a large pill，空格要表示方法，用 how；what/which 不能再當同一個動詞的受詞。

quiz.question: The teacher showed us where to put the bottles and ___ the boxes.
quiz.hint: and 連接 where to put 與 how to sort 兩個名詞片語；how 後面仍用 to + 原形 sort。

quiz.question: The guide taught us how to find clean water and ___ a fire.
quiz.hint: find 和 build 是 and 連接的兩個動作，共用前面的 to，所以 build 也用原形。

quiz.question: She asked the nurse ___ to take the medicine with food.
quiz.hint: 此處表示是否要隨餐服藥，用 whether to take；if 可接完整子句，但不能直接接 to take。

quiz.question: We are wondering how ___ water pollution at school.
quiz.hint: how to reduce 表示如何減少；疑問詞後的不定詞使用 to + 原形 reduce。

quiz.question: The boy needs to learn how ___ before he goes swimming.
quiz.hint: learn how to float 表示學習如何漂浮；how 後用 to + 原形動詞。

quiz.question: Please tell us when ___ the cleanup. We want to arrive on time.
quiz.hint: tell us 後的名詞子句用陳述句語序：when + we + should start；不能用直接問句的 should we start。

quiz.question: The note explains where ___ the empty bottles.
quiz.hint: where 引導名詞子句時，主詞 we 放在 can 前面；can 後接原形 leave，也可簡化成 where to leave the empty bottles。

quiz.question: After the disaster, the children learned who ___ for help.
quiz.hint: who to ask for help 表示該向誰求助；who 是 ask 的受詞，後接 to + 原形 ask。

quiz.question: Please show me how ___ this word. I can't say it.
quiz.hint: how to pronounce 表示如何發音；show me 後接 how + to + 原形動詞。

quiz.question: I am still deciding what ___ to the class party.
quiz.hint: what to bring 表示該帶什麼；what 是 bring 的受詞，不定詞使用 to bring。

quiz.question: The rules tell us which door ___ during a fire.
quiz.hint: which door to use 表示該使用哪一扇門；which + 名詞後接 to + 原形動詞。

quiz.question: Do you know how to turn off the water and ___ the floor?
quiz.hint: turn off 與 clean 是並列動作，共用 how to；clean 用原形，不能改成 cleaning 或 cleaned。

quiz.question: The bus stop has moved. Could you tell me where ___ for the bus?
quiz.hint: where to wait 表示該在哪裡等候；where 後接 to + 原形 wait。

quiz.question: Many creatures live in this forest. Some are active at night. ___ are active during the day.
quiz.hint: 空格後沒有名詞，而且動詞是 are，因此用複數代名詞 Others；Other 不能在此單獨使用，Another/The other 是單數。

quiz.question: Some students reduce waste by reusing bags. ___ students bring their own cups.
quiz.hint: 空格後已有複數名詞 students，用 Other students；Others 後不再接名詞，Another 不接單獨的複數 students。

quiz.question: At the cleanup, some people collect bottles. Others pick up paper. Still ___ wash the bins.
quiz.hint: 第三群用 Still others，後面不接名詞。wash 搭配複數主詞；another/the other 是單數，other 不能在此單獨使用。

quiz.question: Some shops ban plastic bags. Other shops charge for them. Still ___ shops give out free bags.
quiz.hint: 空格後有複數名詞 shops，所以用 Still other shops；others 不能放在 shops 前面。

quiz.question: Many sea creatures are in danger. ___ need cleaner water to survive.
quiz.hint: Some 單獨代表部分生物，搭配 need；Another/The other 是單數，須搭配 needs，Other 不能在此單獨使用。

quiz.question: Some of these drinks contain sugar. ___ do not.
quiz.hint: Others 單獨代表其他一些飲料，搭配 do；Another/The other 是單數，要用 does，Other 在此缺少名詞。

quiz.question: I have two reusable bottles. One is green, and ___ is blue.
quiz.hint: 總共 two bottles，除了 one 只剩另一個，用 the other，搭配 is；others/the others 是複數，other 不能在此單獨使用。

quiz.question: There are exactly three windows. One is open, another is broken, and ___ is closed.
quiz.hint: exactly three 指明三扇窗，說完 one 和 another 後，最後一扇用 the other，搭配 is。

quiz.question: There are ten students in the room. Three are reading, and ___ seven are writing.
quiz.hint: 十人中的三人之外，剩下七人用 the other seven；the others/others 不能放在 seven 前當限定詞，anothers 不是正確字形。

quiz.question: Some creatures live in water; ___ creatures live on land.
quiz.hint: creatures 是複數名詞，其前用 other；others 不直接修飾名詞，another 通常接單數名詞，anothers 不是正確字形。

quiz.question: Some students know how to use this machine. ___ still need help.
quiz.hint: 空格單獨代替其他一些學生，need 搭配複數主詞，所以用 Others；Another/The other 是單數。

quiz.question: Some of the children are learning how to swim. Others are learning how to float. Still ___ are resting.
quiz.hint: Some / Others / Still others 表示三群孩子；第三群搭配 are，需用複數代名詞 others。

quiz.question: Some students find the smell annoying. ___ students do not mind it.
quiz.hint: 空格後有 students，用 Other students；若用 Others，就不能再接 students。Another 不接單獨的複數 students。

quiz.question: After the incident, some people call for help. Others check the road. Still ___ wait by the bus.
quiz.hint: Still others 表示又有另一群人，搭配 wait；another/the other 是單數，須用 waits，other 不能在此單獨使用。

quiz.question: Some plastic bags break down quickly. ___ take many years.
quiz.hint: Others 代替其他一些塑膠袋，搭配 take；Another/The other 是單數，須用 takes，Other 在此後面需要名詞。

quiz.question: Some families cut down on meat. ___ families eat less sugar.
quiz.hint: families 是複數名詞，前面用 Other；Others 已是代名詞，不能再接 families。

quiz.question: Some people make an effort to walk more. ___ ride bikes to work.
quiz.hint: Others 單獨代表其他一些人，搭配 ride；Another/The other 是單數，須用 rides，Other 不能在此單獨使用。

quiz.question: There are three children in the room. One is reading, another is drawing, and ___ is asleep.
quiz.hint: three children 限定三人；one、another 之後，最後一人用 the other，搭配 is。

quiz.question: Many visitors are in the park. ___ are taking photos, others are walking, and still others are sitting.
quiz.hint: 第一群訪客用 Some，搭配 are；One/Another/The other 都是單數，不能與 are 搭配。

quiz.question: At the party, some students are singing. Other students are dancing. Still ___ students are talking.
quiz.hint: 空格後有複數名詞 students，用 Still other students；Still others 不能再接 students。

quiz.question: Some seats are by the window. ___ are near the door.
quiz.hint: Others 代表其他一些座位，搭配 are；Another/The other 是單數，Other 在此缺少名詞。

quiz.question: These are my two bags. One is for school, and ___ is for sports.
quiz.hint: 只有 two bags，提過 one 後，另一個用 the other，搭配 is；others/the others 是複數。

quiz.question: Some machines are currently in use. ___ machines are being cleaned.
quiz.hint: 空格後有複數名詞 machines，用 Other machines；Others 不直接接名詞，Another 通常接單數名詞。

quiz.question: We have several jobs to do after the storm. Some are urgent, but ___ are less urgent.
quiz.hint: 空格代替其他一些工作，搭配 are，所以用複數代名詞 others；another/the other 是單數，other 不能在此單獨使用。

quiz.question: In this class, some students draw pictures. Others write stories. Still ___ make videos.
quiz.hint: Still others 表示又有另一群學生，搭配 make；another/the other 是單數，須用 makes，other 不能在此單獨使用。

vocab.sentence: When Cole feels angry, he often breathes deeply to calm himself down.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 當 Cole 生氣時，他常會深呼吸，讓自己冷靜下來。

vocab.sentence: Rita was so hungry that she took a huge bite of the wheel cake and swallowed it whole.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Rita 餓極了，咬了一大口車輪餅，整口吞了下去。

vocab.sentence: Thanks to the nurse, the injury to Mike's finger soon became less painful.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 多虧護理師幫忙，Mike 手指上的傷很快就沒那麼痛了。

vocab.sentence: It is annoying that people talk during movies.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 有人在電影播放時說話，令人很煩。

vocab.sentence_chinese: 這場颱風是這個地區的一場大災難，許多人因此失去家園。

vocab.sentence: We learned how to survive in the mountains.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們學了如何在山中生存。

vocab.sentence: Cockroaches are one of the creatures that I dislike the most because they make me feel sick.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 蟑螂是我最討厭的生物之一，因為牠們讓我覺得噁心。

vocab.sentence: To protect the environment, we can choose to use reusable chopsticks instead of single-use ones.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 為了保護環境，我們可以選擇使用可重複使用的筷子，而不用免洗筷。

vocab.sentence: Don't throw your trash into the river! You will pollute the water.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 別把垃圾丟進河裡！你會污染河水。

vocab.sentence: My sister loves to float her toy rubber ducks on the water when she takes a bath.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我妹妹洗澡時，喜歡讓她的玩具橡皮鴨浮在水面上。

vocab.sentence: Despite the bad weather, the boat arrived at the shore without incident.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 雖然天氣不好，船仍平安抵達岸邊。

vocab.sentence: Ryan is in urgent need of medicine, or he may become too weak to stand.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Ryan 急需藥物，否則他可能會虛弱得無法站立。

vocab.sentence: This laptop is on sale. The price has been reduced from twenty thousand to ten thousand dollars.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這台筆電正在特價，價格已從兩萬元降到一萬元。

vocab.sentence: The baby is making an effort to climb the stairs by himself.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這個寶寶正努力自己爬上樓梯。

vocab.sentence: Mandy and Brian's relationship is in crisis. They fight more and more often.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Mandy 和 Brian 的感情出現危機，他們吵架的次數越來越多。

vocab.sentence: I learned how to cook. Meanwhile, my brother washed the dishes.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我學習如何煮飯，同時我哥哥在洗碗。

vocab.sentence: Smoking is banned in this restaurant, so customers need to go outside to smoke.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這間餐廳禁止吸菸，因此顧客必須到外面抽菸。

vocab.sentence: Tickets to that show are currently available, so let's get some soon.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那場表演目前還有票，我們趕快買幾張吧。

vocab.sentence: I was wondering who put this love letter in my desk drawer.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我在想，是誰把這封情書放進我的書桌抽屜裡。

phrases.sentence: When Mary realized that she stepped on Jack's foot by accident, she immediately apologized to him.
phrases.sentence_chinese: Mary 發現自己不小心踩到 Jack 的腳時，立刻向他道歉。

phrases.sentence: Leo drank too much, so he is now throwing up in the restroom.
phrases.sentence_chinese: Leo 喝太多了，所以現在正在廁所嘔吐。

phrases.sentence: The doctor said that there was too much gas in my stomach because the food wasn't broken down well enough.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 醫生說我的胃裡有太多氣體，因為食物沒有被充分分解。

phrases.sentence: Kate decided to cut down on sugary drinks to stay healthy.
phrases.sentence_chinese: Kate 決定少喝含糖飲料，以保持健康。

grammar.sentence: Please show me how to breathe more slowly.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 請教我如何放慢呼吸。

grammar.sentence: Some creatures sleep at night, but others stay awake.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有些生物在晚上睡覺，其他一些則保持清醒。

grammar.sentence: We must learn what to do during a disaster.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們必須學會災難發生時該做什麼。

grammar.sentence: Some students walk to school, and others ride bikes.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有些學生走路上學，其他一些則騎腳踏車。

grammar.sentence: The nurse explained how to swallow the small pill.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 護理師解釋了如何吞下那顆小藥丸。

grammar.sentence: Some bags are red, and other bags are blue.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有些袋子是紅色的，其他一些袋子是藍色的。

grammar.sentence: Do you know who to call about the incident?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你知道該打電話給誰詢問那起事件嗎？

grammar.sentence: Some students read, others write, and still others draw.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有些學生閱讀，有些寫字，還有一些畫畫。

grammar.sentence: They are discussing whether to close the park today.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 他們正在討論今天是否要關閉公園。

grammar.sentence: Some shops sell food, and others sell clothes.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有些商店賣食物，其他一些則賣衣服。

grammar.sentence: She taught me how to float in the water.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 她教我如何在水中漂浮。

grammar.sentence: Some children swim, and other children play volleyball.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有些孩子游泳，其他一些孩子打排球。

grammar.sentence: We haven't decided when to start the cleanup.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們還沒決定何時開始清理。

grammar.sentence: Some visitors walk, others run, and still others cycle.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有些遊客走路，有些跑步，還有一些騎腳踏車。

grammar.sentence: I wonder which book to read this weekend.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我在想這個週末該讀哪一本書。

grammar.sentence: Some drinks are sweet, but others have no sugar.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有些飲料很甜，其他一些則沒有糖。

grammar.sentence: Dad showed us how to reduce food waste.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 爸爸教我們如何減少食物浪費。

grammar.sentence: Some people reuse bags, and others reuse bottles.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有些人重複使用袋子，其他一些則重複使用瓶子。

grammar.sentence: He learned how to cut down on sugar.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 他學會了如何減少糖分攝取。

grammar.sentence: Some students know what to do in a crisis.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有些學生知道在危機中該做什麼。

grammar.sentence: Please tell me where to put these empty boxes.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 請告訴我該把這些空箱子放在哪裡。

grammar.sentence: Some toys float, but other toys sink in water.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有些玩具會漂浮，其他一些玩具則會沉入水中。

grammar.sentence: The guide explained how to survive in the forest.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 嚮導解釋了如何在森林中生存。

grammar.sentence: Some people cook, others clean, and still others rest.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有些人煮飯，有些人打掃，還有一些人休息。

grammar.sentence: I don't know what to do about this noise.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我不知道該如何處理這個噪音問題。

grammar.sentence: One bottle is empty, and the other is full.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 一個瓶子是空的，另一個則是滿的。

grammar.sentence: They are wondering how to protect the environment.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 他們正在想如何保護環境。

grammar.sentence: Some phones are new, and others are old.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有些手機是新的，其他一些則是舊的。

grammar.sentence: We need to decide which road to take.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們需要決定該走哪條路。

grammar.sentence: Some tasks are urgent, but other tasks can wait.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有些工作很緊急，其他一些工作則可以等。
